verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's Experimentation feature explicitly supports serving multivariate (A/B/n) flag variations, collecting events into a managed data warehouse, and reading results via a built-in Bayesian statistics engine, directly matching the PM story of running A/B/MVT tests and seeing which variation wins on metrics. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the experimentation UI in action (e.g., screenshots or third-party reports of actual win/loss determination), and detail on which metrics/goals can be tracked or how statistical significance is surfaced to a non-technical PM.
